fields.description: Sole gate for whether this product is live on Shopify (replaces Item.sync_to_shopify).

fields.description: Blank inherits Item.description at push time.

fields.description: Simple/no-variant products only (irrelevant, hidden, for real multi-variant products -- see each variant row's own Variant Price instead). Blank inherits the Item Price on the connector's selling price list.

fields.description: Blank inherits Item.sh_shopify_category at push time.
fields.label: Listing Category

fields.description: Blank inherits Item.sh_shopify_product_type at push time.

fields.description: Shopify product metafields, fetched in full on import (all namespaces, all pages) and pushed back on export via metafieldsSet.
fields.label: Metafields

fields.description: Owning copy of the Shopify product id. Set by the connector on push/import. Never hand-edited.
fields.label: Shopify Product ID

fields.description: Overrides the Item's Shopify SEO Title for this channel. Blank falls back to the Item, then to the listing title -- the same default Shopify's own admin shows.
fields.label: SEO Title

fields.description: Overrides the Item's Shopify SEO Description. Blank falls back to the Item, then to the description as plain text, capped at 320 characters as Shopify's admin does.
